concerns.text: The plan proposes using a paired Wilcoxon signed‑rank test on the per‑sample *coverage* indicator (binary 0/1). Wilcoxon assumes continuous or at least ordinal data; for binary outcomes a test such as McNemar’s or a paired proportion test would be more appropriate. This mismatch threatens the validity of the statistical conclusions about coverage differences.

The Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) method is described as “trained on ≤ 2000 samples; applied to the same features” and later as “applied to the MLP’s deterministic predictions to obtain a predictive variance (via a GP wrapper)”. Using a GP as a wrapper on deterministic MLP outputs does not provide a principled Bayesian posterior for the original material property; it may conflate model misspecification with uncertainty, compromising construct validity of the GPR uncertainty estimates.
